text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: I'm about to merge a docs PR that reorganizes the Optimize toolkit snippets (batching + prefetch). Need a quick sweep so we don't ship broken SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123
Oliver Chen: Thanks — on it. Quick Q: did you change the JS SDK sample for kv-prefetch? Our Python example still uses the old param name.
Maya Patel: Yes — changed opts.prefetch -> opts.kv_prefetch to be explicit (aligns with runtime API). I'll add a migration note.
Sasha Rivera: Can you paste the updated snippet? I'll run it through the sample harness.
Maya Patel: ```js
const client = new RedwoodOptimize({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API });
await client.optimize({ model: 'redwood-2', batching: { maxBatchTokens: 4096 }, kv_prefetch: true });
```
Priya Nair: Heads-up: I renamed the quant profiles landing page in my other PR. Link moved from /docs/optimize/quant-profiles -> /docs/optimize/quantization/profiles — might conflict with redirects.
Oliver Chen: If the rename goes out without redirects we will get a bunch of 404s in the console telemetry. Add a redirect rule.
docs-bot: Deploy preview is ready: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai (checks green)
Liam O'Connor: I can add a redirect in netlify.toml. Ping me once both PRs are merged.
Maya Patel: I'll hold for ~15m to catch any blockers. If none, I'll merge and tag @release-watch.
Priya Nair: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny follow-up to update the Python kwargs to match kv_prefetch too.
Oliver Chen: Minor nit — the JS snippet should mention stream: true for large responses. Otherwise folks hit memory issues.
Maya Patel: Added a comment in the PR with that note. Merging now unless someone objects.
docs-bot: Merged by Maya Patel at 5209876601. CI green. Triggering docs rebuild.
Sasha Rivera: Running smoke tests... one broken link found: /docs/optimize/prefetch -> 404 (reported in PR 4124).
Maya Patel: Ok leaving redirect task open; @Liam please merge the netlify change after PR 4124 lands.
Liam O'Connor: On it. I'll also add a small console blurb about unit-cost impact when using aggressive batching + kv_prefetch.
Sasha Rivera: Smoke tests pass after the redirect patch — marking this thread resolved from my side.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: (1) Priya's Python snippet PR to rename the param; (2) Liam's redirect + netlify merge; (3) Oliver to add stream note to SDK examples.
Oliver Chen: Will update the JS SDK examples and add a tiny e2e test.
Maya Patel: Closing out — will watch post-rebuild for any telemetry spikes.
